kProductionProjection.displayedProjectionSummary: hr-props-raw.json pitchers[].projectedKs is the resolved production K projection: K Projection V3 (mlb-k-projection-v3) where the row's V3 block passes the production gate, K Projection V2.2 (mlb-k-projection-v2-production) where it does not -- openers, relievers and pitchers with no usable game log are refused by V3 by design -- and the legacy IP x K9 / 9 projection as a per-row fail-safe fallback only. pitchers[].projectionSource records which produced each row.
